notes.title: Update and open test in Google Play
notes.content:
Hello dear players, today there is a new small update and an open test in the Google Play store, here's what has changed in this update:
[list]
[*] Added difficulty levels
[*] Bug fix in inventory
[*] Flashlight fix
[*] Some optimization
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
Now about the open test, in order to take part in it, you need to sign up for it using this link: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.CaTaTo.HelloFromDarkness
there or here you can download the game: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CaTaTo.HelloFromDarkness
It will be free to play on the Google Play store, but in-game ads will be added after the open test ends.

notes.title: Plans for a future update
notes.content:
Hello dear players again, I would like to share with you what we are planning to release in the next update, it should be released approximately in the middle or end of next month, but maybe even earlier:
[list]
[*] 2 new levels 1 of which is coordially different from the rest of the gameplay
[*] support for windows 32 platform, now the game can run on a 32-bit version of windows
[*] first level update
[*]difficulty levels
[/list]
